root.speaker: Captain Tor
root.text: Halt there, traveler. Valenfrost opens its gates only to those with an honest purpose. State your business in the hold.

choices.label: I seek an audience with Jarl Sigurd regarding the mountain portents.
I am a wanderer seeking trade and a warm hearth.
[Persuasion] You look like a man who knows good steel when he sees it. I have come to offer my sword.
Farewell, Captain.

node_jarl_audience.speaker: Captain Tor
node_jarl_audience.text: You and half the North, friend. Earth-tremors have shaken the chimneys for a week. The Jarl holds court in the High Mead-Hall. Mind your tongue before his huscarls.

choices.label: Thank you, Captain. I shall tread respectfully.

node_trade_entry.speaker: Captain Tor
node_trade_entry.text: Head down to the Trade Plaza then. Merchant Astrid keeps fair scales, and Bjorn's forge is always hot. Obey the hold peace and you will find no trouble here.

choices.label: Understood.

node_persuade_success.speaker: Captain Tor
node_persuade_success.text: Ha! A confident stride and a sharp eye. We always have room on the ramparts for warriors of mettle. Take this smoked venison for your trouble.

choices.label: Much obliged, Captain.

node_persuade_failure.speaker: Captain Tor
node_persuade_failure.text: Big words are cheap in the taverns. Show your worth on the road before you boast to the hold watch.

choices.label: I will prove myself soon enough.

root.speaker: Jarl Sigurd
root.text: Step forward to the hearthfire, traveler. What news do you bring to Valenfrost while Mount Wyrmfang trembles above us?

choices.label: I have come to offer my blade to quell the threat of the Frost Wyrm.
What can you tell me of the ancient calamity four centuries ago?
I brought word from the Whispering Woods. The dead walk the barrows.
I take my leave, my Lord.

node_offer_aid.speaker: Jarl Sigurd
node_offer_aid.text: Then hear the oath of Valenfrost! In the First Age, High King Valen forged three celestial Star-Keys to bind the wyrm Vyr beneath Mount Wyrmfang. One rests in the Grimstone Vault, one at the Spire of Frostmere, and one was buried with Chieftain Skallagrim. Recover them, and you shall decide the fate of the North!

choices.label: I swear by Torvald to recover the Star-Keys.

node_calamity_lore.speaker: Jarl Sigurd
node_calamity_lore.text: Four hundred winters past, the Frost Wyrm Vyr blackened the skies with blizzard breath, shattering the ancient High Kingdom into our separate holds. If the beast awakens unchained, the age of mortals is finished.

choices.label: We must prevent that awakening at all costs.

node_barrow_report.speaker: Jarl Sigurd
node_barrow_report.text: Aye, Chieftain Skallagrim's tomb stirs with restless dead. If you dare enter the Weeping Barrow Stones, put the ancient chieftain to rest and claim his Star-Key.

choices.label: I will enter the barrows and silence the dead.

root.speaker: Skald Einar
root.text: Greetings, wayfarer! The mead is sweet and the harp strings are tuned. Would you hear the Lay of High King Valen or perhaps the Riddle of the Frost Spire?

choices.label: Sing for me the Lay of High King Valen.
Tell me of the riddle inscribed upon the Spire of Frostmere.
Keep your songs, Skald. Farewell.

node_valen_lay.speaker: Skald Einar
node_valen_lay.text: 'On Wyrmfang's crest the star-iron shone, three celestial keys of stone, to bind the beast in frozen sleep, until the bells of winter weep...' A stirring verse, no?

choices.label: A true song of heroes.

node_spire_hint.speaker: Skald Einar
node_spire_hint.text: The ice mages inscribed their outer pillar with an ancient enigma of the blizzard. 'It bites without teeth, it builds up the glacier, yet withers to water when sun shows its lights.' Remember that when you face the pillar!

choices.label: I will keep that in mind.

root.speaker: Karl the Iron-Ribbed
root.text: Stand upright! If you want to join the Iron Covenant, you must prove you can take a blow and crack troll skull with equal relish.

choices.label: What must I do to prove myself to the Iron Covenant?
[Hire Companion] I could use your greataxe on my travels (35 drachmae).
I will return when my shield is ready.

node_covenant_task.speaker: Karl the Iron-Ribbed
node_covenant_task.text: Down in Grimstone Mine, Shaft Nine was overrun by a feral mountain frost troll. Slay the brute and bring back its thickhide, and you will be one of us.

choices.label: Consider the beast slain.

node_hire_karl.speaker: Karl the Iron-Ribbed
node_hire_karl.text: Agreed! Keep the mead flagon full and let us smash some draugr skulls together.

choices.label: Welcome to the vanguard, Karl.

root.speaker: Valeria Shadow-Gilded
root.text: Welcome to the cisterns. In Mistglen, the water is deep and the eyes are everywhere. Speak softly or do not speak at all.

choices.label: I hear the Whispering Cabal has work for a nimble hand.
I have recovered your stolen smuggling ledger from Captain Malik.
I am merely looking around. Farewell.

node_cabal_work.speaker: Valeria Shadow-Gilded
node_cabal_work.text: Marauder Malik raided our canal courier and took our cipher ledger to the Drowned Fort. Get it back, and the Cabal will reward you with cold silver and our finest stiletto.

choices.label: I will retrieve your ledger.

node_turn_in_ledger.speaker: Valeria Shadow-Gilded
node_turn_in_ledger.text: Splendid work! Not a drop of bog water on the parchment. Take this stiletto and forty drachmae with our gratitude.

choices.label: A pleasure doing business with the Cabal.

root.speaker: Archmage Kallan
root.text: You stand within the Spire of Frostmere. The crystals resonate with high celestial magic. What brings you to the court of the Winter Circle?

choices.label: I seek the Star-Key of the Glacial Spire to reinforce the wyrm's seals.
Teach me of the runecraft used to bind elemental frost.
Farewell, Grand Magister.

node_ask_star_key.speaker: Archmage Kallan
node_ask_star_key.text: The Star-Key is preserved within our locked Arcanum. Only one who comprehends the enigma of the outer Rime Pillar may obtain the silver key to enter.

choices.label: I shall decipher the pillar and prove my wisdom.

node_runecraft_lore.speaker: Archmage Kallan
node_runecraft_lore.text: True runecraft requires harmonizing meteoric sky-iron with the cold resonance of glacier water. Those who master it can carve wards that turn dragon fire into harmless snow.

choices.label: Fascinating knowledge.

root.speaker: Overseer Thrain
root.text: Curse those blue-hided trolls! Smashing up timber beams and making off with my iron vault key in Shaft Nine!

choices.label: What vault key are you shouting about, Overseer?
I found your lost iron key in Shaft Nine!
I will leave you to your mining.

node_vault_story.speaker: Overseer Thrain
node_vault_story.text: The ancestral vault holding Clan Silver-Kin's Star-Key and pure silver ingots! If you venture into Shaft Nine and recover my key, half the clan treasures are yours!

choices.label: I will find your key and clear the shaft.

node_return_key.speaker: Overseer Thrain
node_return_key.text: By Torvald's beard, you found it! The vault door in Shaft Nine is yours to unlock. Take this silver ingot with my deepest thanks!

choices.label: Glad to assist the Silver Kin.

root.speaker: Astrid
root.text: Warm greetings! The cold biting out there? Inspect my wares: broadswords, rations, and reliable lockpicks.

choices.label: Show me your goods.

root.speaker: Bjorn
root.text: Need river-iron or a good mountain broadsword? You have come to the right anvil.

choices.label: Let me see your metalwork.

root.speaker: Ulf White-Wolf
root.text: The woods are full of hungry wolves this season. Need a warm wolf-pelt or an ash longbow?

choices.label: Let me trade for wilderness gear.

root.speaker: Hagan
root.text: Mind your footing on the wet pilings, friend. The bog waters run deep under Mistglen.

choices.label: Farewell, boatman.

root.speaker: Mira
root.text: A stool by the stove and a mug of bitter ale will wash the fen chill out of your bones.

choices.label: Pour me an ale.

root.speaker: Malik the Drowned
root.text: You walked into the wrong fort, soft-skin. Hand over your coin purse or feed the marsh eels!

choices.label: [Combat] Draw your blade, brigand!

root.speaker: Morrigan
root.text: I smelled your blood coming through the fog... Need frost lichen or viper venom, child?

choices.label: Show me your remedies and extracts.

root.speaker: Durn Silver-Shield
root.text: Grimstone stands eternal. Keep your weapons sheathed within clan halls and we will have peace.

choices.label: Understood, warden.

root.speaker: Helga Anvil-Mother
root.text: You stand before the magma fires of the Blackforge. Here we forge armor that withstands dragon talons.

choices.label: Show me your masterwork craft.

root.speaker: Freya
root.text: Quiet in the Arcanum, please. The ink on these First-Age dragon manuscripts is delicate.

choices.label: I shall tread softly.
